title: Effect of Customer-Centric Structure on Long-Term Financial Performance
authors: Ju-Yeon Lee; Shrihari Sridhar; Conor M. Henderson; Robert W. Palmatier
main_or_robustness: main (Bayesian dueling-mediator model with latent instrumental variables for the endogenous customer-centric structure choice, Fortune 500 firms 1998-2010)

ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: Bayesian mediation model (performance on satisfaction and coordinating-cost mediators and on customer_centric_structure) with latent instrumental variables for structure, time-varying firm controls (competitor_structure, competitive_intensity, industry_profitability, firm_scope, firm_size, service ratio, restructuring_charges, industry_growth); no firm or year fixed effects; structure switches on and off within firm; not a DiD

eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Bayesian mediation with latent instruments; no unit/time FE; structure toggles.
design_notes: MKSC.2014.0878Code.txt is WinBUGS pseudo-code (one mediator shown, '...' for controls). customer_centric_structure is a binary firm-year indicator that can switch off and on (firm 1: 1 in years 1-4, 0 in 5-10, 1 in 11-13), so even the underlying variation is not a clean staggered adoption; the estimator is not a DiD, so near_miss is false.
estimators_reported: Bayesian mediation model with latent instrumental variables (WinBUGS)
data_files_note: Data file is a 29-row illustrative extract for 3 firms (anonymous firm and year indices) of a Fortune 500 panel; no stated sampling rule. Underlying sources (Compustat, ACSI, hand-coded structure) are licensed.
data_provenance_note: Small extract with no stated random sampling rule counts as not_shipped (Nov 1 rule).
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read where available; package_mismatch checked against title, authors and README. Regression inventory empty (0 lines); code read directly.
